name_input: KLASSIC WHEELS LTD; KLASSIC WHEELS LTD.,; KLASSIC WHEELS LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for KLASSIC WHEELS LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/klassic-wheels-limited) shows 226 records, but the visible rows are all INBOUND: "2026-02-04 EXCEL RIM SDN. BHD. KLASSIC WHEELS LIMITED MOTORCYCLE ALUMINIUM ALLOY RIM JU131147 ... Port Kelang, MALAYSIA -> NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India 87141090 BOL 7308280". The only outbound hint is a buyer-side entry "2 OTR WHEEL ENGINEERING LANKA PVT.LT ... KLASSIC WHEELS LIMITED, NO. 218, MINUWANGODA ROADEKALA, SRI LANKA" with no date, no HS code and no B/L number. Source counter: page states "Total Shipments 226 Records detected"; rows actually seen = 5 dated import records + 1 undated Sri Lanka buyer line. No dated export B/L with destination and HS code was retrievable.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and volza.com all returned HTTP 403; the web_search backend was down (connection refused) and Bing returned only irrelevant results. Nothing verifiable on domestic supply was obtained.
note: Company exists and is active in Indian customs data (address on file: L-2 M.I.D.C AREA). The 226-record customs footprint is dominated by IMPORTS of motorcycle aluminium alloy rims from Excel Rim (Malaysia/Japan) under HS 87141090 / 87149290 — i.e. Klassic Wheels appears here as an importer/assembler, not as a demonstrated exporter. Declared HS 870870 (road-wheel parts) is not the code seen in the records; per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual codes observed are 87141090 and 87149290, so the code should be corrected to the factual one. Export status is 'declared_only' strictly because a single undated Sri Lanka buyer line exists; no dated export shipment with destination, HS and B/L was found, so no export shipment is confirmed. Domestic supply: no evidence obtained either way — 'unknown', not 'none_found', because the registries were blocked rather than checked. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN/PAN confirmed from a primary source; the CIN U35999PB1985PLC006228 was NOT verified and is therefore not asserted.
